elements.label: Question-Containing Threads
elements.description: Parent threads where GPT-5-mini extracted at least one real question. The labeled comment set used by every downstream analysis is drawn from this slice.

elements.label: Eligible Parent Comments
elements.description: Top-level comments only. Replies are bundled into their parent thread for the question filter pass, so the funnel collapses 93k comments into 67k parents.

elements.label: Total Comments (including replies)
elements.description: Every comment harvested from the 739 source videos, including replies on threads. This is the raw YouTube harvest before any filtering.

elements.label: Non-Question
elements.description: Parent threads where the GPT-5-mini classifier did not identify a question. These are excluded from the question-resolution analysis.

elements.label: Question-Containing
elements.description: Parent threads where the GPT-5-mini classifier extracted at least one real question. These feed the resolution-rate metric and the labeled sample set.
